title: byom_akson_dispatch_v1 driver arguments (DESIGN.md §17.2; family contract L61–L64)
description: What Kovee's byom_akson_dispatch_v1 effect driver requires before it may dispatch: the current delegation act, the consumed byom permit (ExecutionConsumptionReceipt), the inert idempotently staged contract, the exact Akson consent, the current Kovee effect fence, and the stable execution/delivery keys. §17.2 states these preconditions in prose without a field block (recorded gap — slice-2 gap notes); member names derive from the §13.1/§17.2 records they cite. Kovee is the SOLE caller (L63): byom's delegation engine authorizes and never calls; a generic Kovee tool, Byom participant, or byomd adapter cannot call the surface; current Sage-only Akson driver authority is not reusable by relabeling (§16.6 item 11). Consumption is atomic with egress: Kovee ExternalAuthorizationConsumption{phase: atomic_with_egress} — a Kovee field, not a byom receipt field (L40–L43, L64).

caller.description: Kovee is the sole caller (family contract L63); byom never calls Akson or holds Akson credentials.

act_intent_ref.description: The current consumed delegation ActIntent (§13.1); a canceled or superseded intent denies dispatch.

execution_consumption_receipt_ref.description: The consumed byom permit: the one immutable ExecutionConsumptionReceipt from execution_permit_consume (R34, one-shot key, dual fences).

staged_contract_ref.description: The server-prepared contract staged inertly and idempotently on the versioned Akson surface (§17.2); staging grants nothing.

akson_consent_ref.description: Akson's one-shot local consent for the exact staged contract, consumed atomically with dispatch (§17.2; §13.2: a different sovereign boundary, not duplicate approval).

kovee_effect_ref.description: Kovee's durable local Effect under the same stable execution key (§13.1 step 3).

kovee_effect_fence.description: The current Kovee effect fence (§17.2); a stale fence denies dispatch.

delivery_key.description: The stable delivery key every signed exchange object binds (§17.2 chain identity).

identifier.description: Opaque visible-ASCII identifier, at most 128 bytes (§14.9).

safeNonNegativeInteger.description: I-JSON safe integer (§14.2 rejects unsafe integers).

digestRef.$comment: The closed family DigestRef wire (family-vectors/PROFILE.md §6.1, normative; D-R0-1): exactly the members {class, algorithm, key_ref?, value_hex}. The oneOf pins the closed class/algorithm pairing and requires key_ref exactly for the keyed erasure classes; each arm refines members of this already-closed object.

class.description: Digest class (PROFILE.md §6, D-R0-1); substituting one class where a schema requires another is a conformance failure.

key_ref.description: Key id for the keyed erasure classes; raw HMAC keys, per-object secrets, and salts are never part of a DigestRef.

digestRef.description: Typed DigestRef: every digest field is typed, never an unlabelled hash. Wire shape, class/algorithm pairing, and key_ref presence per the ratified family profile.
